command_line:
set -eu
{
  printf 'caper_path='; command -v caper || true
  printf 'caper_version='; caper --version 2>&1 || true
  printf 'python_path='; command -v python || true
  printf 'python_version='; python --version 2>&1 || true
  printf 'wdls='; find /opt /usr/local /app /workspace -maxdepth 7 -type f -name 'atac.wdl' -print 2>/dev/null || true
  printf 'pipeline_scripts='; find /opt /usr/local /app /workspace -maxdepth 7 -type f -name 'croo' -o -name 'atac-seq-pipeline.py' 2>/dev/null || true
} > runtime_probe.txt
